name: kelpie
description: Herding coding agents in herdr: review a task's changes in a split next to Claude, with unified diffs in nvim, line comments typed into Claude's input box, read marks, scoped and live reviews, and worktree-aware bases.

auto_open.title: Open the review pane automatically
auto_open.description: Open a live review split next to a task's Claude on its first file edit in a session (inside herdr, in a git worktree only). Closing the pane keeps it closed for that session.
